name: The Speech Accent Archive
description: The Speech Accent Archive is a phonetic research resource established at George Mason University. It contains audio recordings and time-aligned phonetic transcriptions of 2,140 speakers from 177 countries reading the same English elicitation paragraph, enabling systematic study of non-native accents and dialect phonology.
